examples.ending: 104906901 is a valid formal ending/cutscene ID

auditRules: All IDs must be exactly nine decimal digits and globally unique.
Every next and branch target must exist unless the runtime script intentionally terminates the row.
SceneConfig and ExposeData entry IDs must resolve to a row in their declared AVG file.
The first three digits identify the owning dialogue character/file namespace, not necessarily the current speaker of every row.
Formal runtime contains intentional sequence gaps and reserved 4xx/8xx/9xx ranges; a numeric gap alone is not an issue.
Do not apply the archived Unit9 fixed-leading-9 rule or EPI09 path rules.
